description:
Crimson Moon gets a new trailer showcasing brutal gameplay and a release window announcement. Watch the latest Crimson Moon trailer for this upcoming Gothic High Renaissance action-adventure RPG built around intense, replayable missions. In Crimson Moon, enter the fallen city of Gildenarch and face new enemies and brutal battles, while mastering powerful Nephilim abilities across a dark, replayable world built for relentless hunts and unforgettable encounters. Fight alone or bring a second Nephilim into battle as you push deeper into the city and uncover what waits beyond. 

Crimson Moon will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Steam, and Epic Games Store in September 2026.
title: Crimson Moon - Official Release Window Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a closer look at the enemies standing in Vano’s path, the locations you’ll fight through, and the brutal ways you’ll carve a path to revenge in this latest Nekome: Nazi Hunter trailer for the upcoming single-player action game. Nekome: Nazi Hunter is an original Second World War story about Vano Nastasu, a hellbent army of one. Set in early 1941, Nekome: Nazi Hunter sends you from New York to Nazi-occupied Europe in a personal odyssey of revenge, as Vano pursues Hitler’s Hyenas, a pack of Nazi soldiers who brutally murdered his family. Venture deep into enemy territory to scout routes, plan your assaults, and strike with precision in a mix of stealth and brutal up-close combat to earn every kill. 

Nekome: Nazi Hunter will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Steam, and Epic Games Store in 2027.
title: Nekome: Nazi Hunter - Official '1941' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a look at gameplay and more from Lords of the Fallen 2 in this latest trailer for the upcoming soulslike action-RPG sequel. A millennium after the Great Rupture, the Umbral darkness has consumed almost all. One Kingdom remains—a sacred land shrouded by an ancient force. But as light fades, darkness rises, and the Eternal Night draws near. A hero must rise, for a God to fall.

Lords of the Fallen 2 will be available on Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026. It is also coming to PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S.
title: Lords of the Fallen 2 - Official Switch 2 Announce Trailer | Nintendo Direct June 2026
